title: Mailcall: Claude reads your mailbox and writes the morning summary
description: Mailcall is a Claude Code plugin where Claude reads the person's mailbox and writes a morning summary: what is important, who is waiting for a reply, and a short digest of Google Alerts and newsletters in the person's own words. Main road: the Gmail connector of the person's Claude subscription, no passwords anywhere. Spare road for any mailbox: IMAP strictly read-only, with an app password typed by the person into the system's own keychain, never into a file. Reply drafts only; nothing is sent, deleted or marked without the person's yes. No keys, no paid API.
